long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Hamburg, Karsten Börner began working as a professional captain in 1984. He developed a Baltic charter operation that eventually reached 14 vessels, then sold it in the early 1990s. The sale supplied experience and capital for his next project: buying a retired tug and rebuilding it in the Netherlands as a traditional passenger schooner.

Börner has since combined ownership with hands-on command, operating Mediterranean sailing, diving and activity cruises alongside Karin Volkening. The business grew around a single converted ship rather than a conventional hotel or cruise fleet, making his seafaring skill central to its value. In 2024, Börner and his crew also rescued survivors from a nearby vessel that sank off Sicily.
